preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for word in ['Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', 'Sun'] if word.lower() in input_str.lower())
postconditions.description: The function returns the number of times the words 'Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', and 'Sun' appear in the input string, regardless of case.
